_about: Why an evidence card crosses an option off the case sheet: one sentence per card and column, shown next to 'ruled out by evidence N'. 'base' is the shared story; a variant lists only the cards whose reasons differ (its rules_out differ in case.json). Every rules_out in case.json needs a reason here.

D1.how: The leaked pages are a crooked scan of paper, not a file copied from a laptop.

D2.how: Job 88213 is printed on the leaked pages, and the log shows it printed at the library printer.
D2.where: Job 88213 is printed on the leaked pages, and the log shows it printed at the library printer, LIB-1.

D3.why: The leak is an old draft with questions that will not be in the exam, so nobody could cheat with it.

D5.why: The paper was posted free to all 212 students. Nobody sells what they give away.

L4.how: The Professor's office stayed locked all evening, with no sign of entry.
L4.where: The Professor's office stayed locked all evening, with no sign of entry.

L1.who: Visitors cannot pass the library gate, and the exam was printed inside the library.
L1.how: No staff card passed the library gate, so the staff card that printed the job was not in its owner's hands.

D1.how: The leaked file was never printed or photographed: it was saved from an email attachment.
D1.where: The leaked file was never printed: it was saved on an iPad from an email attachment.

D2.how: Job 88213 was never collected: at midnight it was still waiting in the print queue.
D2.where: Job 88213 was never collected: at midnight it was still waiting in the print queue.
